verdict.rationale: Bugbot reads in-repo `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` files, so review guidelines can live in a versioned file in the repo, and a verbose mode shows which rules were loaded. The evidence does not show path filters, explicit per-path instruction scoping, or review profiles defined in that file. Effort levels and org-wide rules are set in settings and Automations, not in the repo config. Missing for 10: documented path include/exclude filters, explicit per-path/per-directory instruction scoping, repo-defined review profiles, structured config schema, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering lead, I configure the reviewer with a versioned config file in my repo — path filters, per-path instructions, review profiles

citations.quote: Create `.cursor/BUGBOT.md` files in your repository to give Bugbot project-specific review guidelines.
